assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered
The purpose of the ordered service is to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management
The appeal addresses the PR-204 medical necessity determination
